title: Prozorro.Sale Ukraine Auctions input
description: Search public Prozorro.Sale auctions (privatization, lease, land, bankruptcy and bank assets), get full details for auction IDs, or monitor new auctions with alerts.

mode.title: What to do
mode.description: "search" finds auctions matching the filters below (set "Monitor name" to get only new ones on every run). "details" returns full information for the auction IDs you list. "types" lists every selling method (auction type) with its ID prefix; it is free.

auctionIds.title: Auction IDs (details mode)
auctionIds.description: Public auction IDs as shown on prozorro.sale, e.g. LRE001-UA-20260916-77195, or 24-character procedure IDs. Used in "details" mode; if you fill this and leave "What to do" empty, details mode is used.

sellingMethods.title: Auction types (selling methods)
sellingMethods.description: Procedure families or exact selling methods. Examples: smallPrivatization, largePrivatization, legitimatePropertyLease (state/municipal property lease), landRental, landSell, basicSell, bankRuptcy, timber, subsoil, nonperformingLoans, dgf (bank assets). A family covers all its formats (english, dutch, …); an exact value like landRental-english matches only that. Run mode "types" to see the full list. Empty = all types.

statuses.title: Statuses
statuses.description: Only auctions in these statuses. Empty = any status.

openForBidsOnly.title: Only auctions you can still bid on

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Words that must all appear in the title, description, item descriptions or address. Ukrainian works best (e.g. "нежитлове приміщення"); English titles are searched too when the organizer provided them. Case and apostrophes are ignored.

regions.title: Regions / cities
regions.description: Part of the oblast or settlement name in Ukrainian, e.g. "Київ", "Львівська", "Одеса". Matches the address of the auctioned items (the organizer's address only when items have none). Any value may match.

classificationCodes.title: Classification codes (CAV / CPV)
classificationCodes.description: Code or code prefix of the auctioned items, e.g. "04" (real estate), "06" (land), "04121" or "06121000-6". Additional classifications are checked too. Any value may match.

organizerCodes.title: Organizer / owner EDRPOU codes
organizerCodes.description: Ukrainian company registration codes (EDRPOU) of the organizer running the auction or, for lease auctions, the property owner. Leading zeros are optional.

minPrice.title: Starting price from (UAH)
minPrice.description: Minimum starting price. For lease auctions this is the monthly rent.

publishedFrom.title: Published from
publishedFrom.description: Only auctions published on or after this date, e.g. 2026-09-01 or "7 days" (ago). All auctions changed since this date are scanned, so the result is complete for the period (within "Max pages to scan").

publishedTo.title: Published up to
publishedTo.description: Only auctions published on or before this date (a plain date includes the whole day, UTC).

auctionDateFrom.title: Auction date from
auctionDateFrom.description: Only auctions whose bidding session starts on or after this date, e.g. 2026-10-01 or "+3 days" (from now).

auctionDateTo.title: Auction date up to
auctionDateTo.description: Only auctions whose bidding session starts on or before this date, e.g. "+30 days".

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Stop after this many matching auctions (search mode). 0 = no limit. Each returned auction is billed as one result.
maxResults.sectionCaption: 3. How much to scan and return

lookbackHours.title: Look back (hours)
lookbackHours.description: When no "Published from" date is set, scan auctions changed in this many past hours. Also used for the first run of a monitor.

maxPages.title: Max pages to scan
maxPages.description: Safety limit for scanning the change feed. One page = up to 100 auctions. Busy days can have thousands of changes; if the scan is cut short, OUTPUT says so and a monitor continues where it stopped on the next run.

scanMode.title: Scan method
scanMode.description: "auto": if you picked auction types and no date, read the latest 100 auctions of each type (fast); otherwise read every auction changed in the period (complete). "changeFeed" always reads the full period. "latestByType" always reads the latest 100 per type. Monitors always use the change feed.

includeItems.title: Include items (lots)
includeItems.description: List every auctioned item with its classification, quantity, address and properties (area, cadastral number, …).

includeDocuments.title: Include document links
includeDocuments.description: List published documents (announcement, photos, contract, protocol …) with public download URLs.

includeRaw.title: Include raw API record
includeRaw.description: Adds the original, untouched API record under "raw" (about 30 KB per auction).

monitorName.title: Monitor name
monitorName.description: Turns search into a monitor: each run outputs (and notifies about) only auctions this monitor has not reported before. Use a different name for every search you track, e.g. "kyiv-land-rental". Leave empty for a normal search.

alertOn.title: What counts as new
alertOn.description: "newlyPublished": only auctions published after the monitor started. "newlyMatching": also older auctions that start to match your filters (e.g. when they open for bids).

reportAllOnFirstRun.title: Report matches on the first run
reportAllOnFirstRun.description: By default the first run only remembers the current matches (baseline) and reports nothing. Enable to get them all as new on the first run.

resetState.title: Start over
resetState.description: Forget everything this monitor remembered and start a new baseline.

stateStoreName.title: State storage name
stateStoreName.description: Named key-value store where monitors keep their memory between runs. Letters, digits and "-" only.

telegramBotToken.title: Telegram bot token
telegramBotToken.description: Create a bot with @BotFather and paste its token.

telegramChatId.title: Telegram chat ID
telegramChatId.description: Your user, group or channel ID (e.g. 123456789 or -1001234567890). Add the bot to the group or channel first.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Receives a POST with JSON (event, monitorName, newCount, message, auctions[]). Works with Make, Zapier, n8n or your own server.

emailTo.title: Email to
emailTo.description: Sends a summary email through the apify/send-mail Actor (billed as a separate small run on your account). Several addresses: separate with commas.

notifyMaxItems.title: Auctions listed in a message
notifyMaxItems.description: How many auctions Telegram, Slack and email messages list before "…and N more".

webhookMaxItems.title: Auctions included in the webhook
webhookMaxItems.description: Maximum number of auction records in the webhook JSON. The full list is always in the dataset.

notifyOnNoChanges.title: Also notify when nothing is new
notifyOnNoChanges.description: Sends a short "no new auctions" message after every run, useful to know the monitor is alive.

instance.title: Data source
instance.description: "main": procedure.prozorro.sale (privatization, lease, land, bankruptcy, timber, …). "dgf": dgf-procedure.prozorro.sale (assets of failed banks sold by the Deposit Guarantee Fund).

apiBaseUrl.title: API base URL
apiBaseUrl.description: Overrides the data source, e.g. https://procedure-staging.prozorro.sale (test data) or a local mock server. Leave empty.

requestIntervalMs.title: Pause between API requests
requestIntervalMs.description: Minimum time between two requests to the Prozorro.Sale API, to stay polite. Requests are never sent in parallel.

changedSince.title: Scan changes since
changedSince.description: Start of the change-feed scan, overriding "Published from" and "Look back". Useful to find status changes (e.g. completed auctions) in a period.
